sources.title: Google video generation prompt guide
sources.takeaway: Describe subject, action, setting, camera, lighting and visual style explicitly.

sources.title: Runway Gen-4 Video Prompting Guide
sources.takeaway: Start with one clear scene and concrete motion. Add compatible details incrementally; use positive descriptions.

sources.title: Runway Camera Terms, Prompts, & Examples
sources.takeaway: Camera position, focus, movement and lens treatment describe distinct aspects of a shot.

authorship: Original Composition vocabulary and examples informed by the linked references; no scraped prompt collection. These are creative suggestions, not model guarantees.
rules: Infer from meaning, not keyword matching. Preserve explicit subjects, actions, identities and artistic medium.
Composition frames and motion guide own staging, poses, scale and camera movement. Do not invent a replacement shot.
Lens treatment may suggest distortion or focus without moving the camera or changing geometry. Default to restrained distortion unless the user requests stylization.
Quality means readable details and consistent geometry/materials, not an unsupported resolution claim.
Choose a small coherent set of qualities. Explain inferred choices as suggestions. Do not add unrelated subjects or story beats.
Image prompts describe a finished look shared by both endpoint frames. Video prompts describe temporal continuity and motion within the guide.

distortion: deliberate fisheye curvature only when requested
texture: molded plastic seams and tiny scuffs

examples.interpretation: Playful miniature action; preserve toy proportions.
examples.look: A miniature subway built from interlocking toy bricks, with molded plastic surfaces, small seams and scuffs, cool station lamps and warm train windows. Keep the reference frame's pose, placement and perspective.
examples.video: Carry the toy hero through the guide's action and camera path. Keep brick proportions and plastic highlights consistent as the hero passes the station lights.

examples.interpretation: Quiet, subdued mood; wet surfaces support the emotion.
examples.look: Muted blue-gray surroundings, damp textured surfaces and soft reflected practical light. Retain the supplied frame's staging and natural perspective.
examples.video: Follow the guide's timing and camera movement with a restrained evening atmosphere. Reflections remain coherent as the subject moves.

examples.look: Hand-shaped clay with small fingerprints, matte edges and warm diffuse light. Preserve subject placement and pose from the frame.
examples.video: Maintain the guide's trajectory and timing with a handmade clay appearance. Keep fingerprints and character features consistent through the motion.

examples.interpretation: Precise and cool with controlled reflections.
examples.look: Brushed alloy surfaces with fine directional grain and clean cool highlights. Maintain the frame's camera and geometry.
examples.video: Follow the guide while letting highlights travel naturally across the metal. Keep silhouettes stable and the same surface finish from start to finish.
